s1.syndrome_frame: Abdominopelvic mass with respiratory symptoms and history of recent pelvic surgery
salient_findings: Fleshy lesion at the vaginal apex
Poorly differentiated epithelioid cells on biopsy
key_facts: 56-year-old nulliparous woman
14 months after supracervical laparoscopic hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy
History of menorrhagia, pelvic pain, and large uterine leiomyomas
Normal preoperative Pap smear
No chest radiograph or endometrial biopsy obtained preoperatively
Prolonged mechanical morcellation without containment bag during surgery
Superficial pelvic endometriosis noted and cauterized during surgery
Final pathology showed weakly proliferative endometrium, adenomyosis, and leiomyoma
Ovaries showed benign parenchyma and endosalpingiosis
Left lower quadrant pain, persistent cough, and shortness of breath on presentation
Vaginal biopsy showed grade 3 endometrioid adenocarcinoma
Immunohistochemical stains positive for cytokeratin, vimentin, and CD138

differentials: Uterine tumor resembling ovarian sex cord-stromal tumor
per_call: Uterine tumor resembling ovarian sex cord-stromal tumor

shortlist.label: Endometrioid adenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Vaginal biopsy showed grade 3 endometrioid adenocarcinoma

shortlist.label: Undifferentiated uterine sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Poorly differentiated epithelioid cells with hyperchromatic nuclei in necrosis on biopsy

shortlist.label: Leiomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of uterine leiomyomas and recent pelvic surgery with morcellation

shortlist.label: Carcinosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Abdominopelvic mass with respiratory symptoms and history of recent pelvic surgery

shortlist.label: Malignant mixed Mullerian tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Complex clinical presentation with multiple hypermetabolic masses

raw.rationale: Vaginal biopsy showed grade 3 endometrioid adenocarcinoma, and immunohistochemical stains were positive for cytokeratin, which is consistent with this diagnosis

rejected.label: Undifferentiated uterine sarcoma
rejected.why: Lack of specific immunohistochemical markers and inconsistent histological features

rejected.label: Leiomyosarcoma
rejected.why: Negative immunohistochemical stains for SMA and desmin, which are typically positive in leiomyosarcoma

rejected.label: Carcinosarcoma
rejected.why: No evidence of both carcinoma and sarcoma components in the biopsy results

rejected.label: Malignant mixed Mullerian tumor
rejected.why: No evidence of both epithelial and mesenchymal malignant components in the biopsy results
